definitions.gloss: to run through; to dash through
definitions.explanation: To run quickly through a place from one end to the other without stopping.
To pass through a period of time quickly, often used figuratively for busy or intense times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}ける。
examples.english: The wind rushes through the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: The athlete raced straight through to the goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{青春|せいしゅん}→青春：14613_seishun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧。
examples.english: The days that raced through our youth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた。
examples.english: I raced through a busy year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{駆|か}け{抜|ぬ}けた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He was someone who lived his short life to the fullest.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run, to gallop) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to pass through)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the place being passed through

USAGE:
Often used poetically to describe wind, light, or time passing quickly through something.

- ⟦{走|はし}り{抜|ぬ}ける→走り抜ける：noentry⟧: to run through (similar meaning)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る→駆け回る：06113_kakemawaru⟧: to run around
- ⟦{突|つ}き{抜|ぬ}ける→突き抜ける：21651_tsukinukeru⟧: to pierce through
